changelog: Dedicated OpenCode vs. Antigravity System Prompt system: OpenCode chats now use their own live system prompt (per-chat override + isolated OpenCode Global prompt) via a zero-dependency OpenCode V2 bridge plugin without ever inheriting Antigravity's prompt or duplicating prompts into user input (contents)

Exclusive OpenCode systemInstruction: setting a per-chat or global OpenCode system prompt replaces the entire systemInstruction with ONLY your instructions (removing OpenCode's extra boilerplate, # Code Mode dump, and worktree notices) while permanently disabling OpenCode's # Your Model identity block (-opencode.prompt.identity)

Maximized full-screen Chat System Prompt dialog (edge-to-edge width/height with IME support), clearer Active Prompt vs. Edit Override layout, scope switcher (This chat / Global), and live character & token counter
